spans.s:
mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Staying, abiding, what or who is or stays.
E.
ष्ठा to stay or stand, aff. क; this deriv. most usually occurs in composition.

(ए) स्थगे r. 1st cl. (स्थगति)
To cover; also ष्ठग.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
1 Fraudulent, dishonest, a rogue, a cheat.
2 Shameless, abandoned.
f. (-गी)
A betel box.
E.
स्थग to cover or hide, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
Covering, concealment.
E.
स्थग to cover, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Covered, hidden, concealed.
E.
स्थग to cover, क्त aff.

m. (-गुः)
A hump or protuberance on the back, &c.
E.
स्थग to cover, aff. उ.

n. (-लं)
1 A level square piece of ground, prepared for a sacrifice.
2 A boundary, a limit, a land mark.
E.
ष्ठल to be situated, इलच् aff., form irr.

m. (-लः)
1 An ascetic sleeping on the bare ground, or ground prepared for a sacrifice.
2 A mendicant, a religious beggar.
E.
स्थण्डिल ground, &c., अण् aff.

m. (-यी)
A devotee who, as an act of mortification or penance, sleeps on the ground which has been prepared for sacrificial purposes.
E.
स्थण्डिल as above, शी to sleep, णिनि aff.

n. (-कं)
An altar.
E.
स्थण्डिल levelled ground for a sacrifice, षो to destroy, aff. क्त, and कन् added.

m. (-यः)
An ascetic sleeping on the ground: see स्थण्डिलशयिन्.
E.
स्थण्डिल on the ground, and शय who sleeps.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Chief, best, principal.
m. (-तिः)
1 The performer of the VṚHASPATI sacrifice.
2 A guard or attendant of the women's apartments.
3 A sovereign, a chief.
4 An architect, a master carpenter or builder.
5 A carpenter, a wheel-wright.
6 A charioteer.
7 KUVERA.
E.
स्थ who is or who is placed, and पति master, lord.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
1 Distressed, living in difficulty or distress.
2 Bent with pain, &c.
E.
स्थ what stands, or is, पुट to contract, aff. क.

r. 1st cl. (स्थलति)
To stand, to be firm; also ष्ठल.

nf. (-लं-ली)
Place, site, soil, dry or firm ground.
nf. (-लं-ला)
A spot of dry ground prepared by art or drained and raised, &c.
n. (-लं)
1 A tent, a house of cloth.
2 A mound, a hillock.
3 Point, case, subject (of a description or discussion.)
4 Part (of a book.)
E.
ष्ठल to be firm, aff. अच्.

n. (-लं)
1 A caldron.
2 Any culinary utensil.
f. (-ली)
1 An earthen pot or boiler.
2 The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suaveolens.)
E.
ष्ठा to stand, Uṇādi aff. आलच्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Who or what goes on land, terrene.
E.
स्थल, and चर what goes.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Terrene, terrestrial, what is produced on land.
E.
स्थल, and ज born.

n. (-द्मं)
A shrub, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
E.
स्थल dry ground, and पद्म a lotus.

f. (-नी)
A shrub, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
E.
स्थल dry ground, and पद्मिनी a cluster of lotuses.

f. (-री)
A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)
E.
स्थल dry ground, and मञ्जरी a stalk.

m. (-हः)
Battle on plain or level ground.
E.
स्थल, and विग्रह war.

m. (-टः)
A plant, (Tribulus lanuginosus.)
E.
स्थल dry ground, and शृङ्गाट a sort of trapa; also with कन् added, स्थलशृङ्गाटक.

m. (-मा)
A boundary, a land-mark.
E.
स्थल dry ground, and सीमन् a boundary.

f. (-ता)
A terrestrial demigod, as a faun, a dryad, &c.
E.
स्थली the dry land, and देवता a divinity.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating or belonging to dry ground.
E.
स्थल, and छ aff.

m. (-यः)
An amphibious animal, as the tortoise, otter, &c.
E.
स्थले on dry ground, and शय who sleeps.

m. (-विः)
A weaver.
E.
स्था to stay, Uṇādi aff. क्विन्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Old, aged.
2 Fixed, firm, steady.
m. (-रः)
1

BRAHMĀ.
2

An old man.
E.
ष्ठा to stay or stand, (a long time, &c.) किरच् Uṇādi aff., and स्थव substituted for the root.

n. (-रं)
Old age, any time after seventy in men, and fifty in women.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, (a long time,) किरच् Uṇādi aff., and युक् augment.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्टं)
Very fat or corpulent.
E.
स्थूल bulky, इष्ठन् superlative affix, the final of the adjective dropped, and vowel changed; also with ईयसुन् similar aff. स्थवीयम् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः).

mfn. (-णुः-णुः-णु)
Firm, fixed, steady, stable.
m. (-णुः)
1 Ś

IVA.
2

A stake, a pin.
3 A post.
4 A spear, a dart.
5 A nest of white ants.
mn. (-णुः-णु)
1 The trunk of a tree of which the branches have been lopped off.
2 The trunk of any tree.
E.
ष्ठा to stand, Uṇādi aff. नु.

m. (-दः)
One who cuts down or clears away timber.
E.
स्थाणु, and छेद who cuts.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be placed or fixed.
2 To be appointed or determined, to be ordained or agreed upon.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who or what stays or stands.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, aff. तृन्.

n. (-नं)
1 Place, spot, site, situation.
2 Stay, staying, continuance, being fixed or stationary and exempt from increase or diminution.
3 Likeness, resemblance.
4 Leisure, interval.
5 An open place in a town, a green, a plain, a square.
6 A house, a dwelling.
7 A section, a chapter, a book.
8 One of the three objects of government, the middle state, as neither loss nor gain, nor discomfiture nor success, nor expenditure nor accumulation, &c.
9 A town, a city.
10 Office, appointment.
11 Degree, station.
12

Halt.
13

Firmness of troops, keeping in array.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, to be fixed, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-कं)
1 A basin or trench dug for water at the root of a tree.
2 A town, a city.
3 A bubble or a bead on spirits or wine.
E.
कन added to the last.

f. (-ला)
A plant, (Ocimum pilosum.)
E.
स्थान place, चञ्चला trembling.

m. (-लः)
A guard, a keeper, a watchman.
E.
स्थान a place, and पाल who protects.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Displaced, out of place, fallen or removed from the natural or usual situation.
E.
स्थान place, and भ्रष्ट fallen.

m. (-गः)
1 Assignment of suitable places.
2 Proper mode or place for preserving articles.
E.
स्थान, and योग application.

m. (-क्षः)
The superintendant or governor of a place or post.
E.
स्थान a place, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.

m. (-धः)
Confinement to a place, imprisonment, arrest.
E.
स्थान, and आसेध durance.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Local, belonging to place or site.
m. (-कः)
The governor, or superintendant of any place or district.
E.
स्थान a place, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Having place or fixation, placed, abiding, permanent, &c.
E.
स्थान place, इनि aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating or suitable to any place, fit for or belonging to it, &c.
n. (-यं)
A city, a town.
E.
स्थान place, and छ aff.

ind.
1 Properly, suitably, fitly.
2 Because, on account of.
3 Like, resembling, similarly.
4 Truly.
E.
स्थान place, in the seventh case.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Placing, fixing, regulating, ordering.
m. (-कः)
1 The director of the stage business, a stage manager.
2 A founder, the erector of a temple or image, &c.
E.
ष्ठा to be or stand, causal form, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-त्यः)
A guard of the women's apartments.
E.
स्था who stays, (in the haram, the wife or concubine of a man of rank,) and पति master, ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Placing, founding, fixing, erecting.
2 Ordering, directing.
3 Fixing or concentrating the thoughts upon the object of meditation, abstraction, mental controul.
4 A ceremony performed in the month of utero-gestation.
5 A dwelling, a habitation.
f. (-ना)
Ordering or arranging as a drama, stage management.
f. (-नी)
A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
E.
ष्ठा to stay or stand, causal form, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Fixing, placing, establishing.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, causal v., शतृ aff.

ind.
Having placed, fixed, erected, &c.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, causal v., क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Deposited, placed.
2 Ordered, directed.
3 Certain, established, ascertained.
4 Firm, steady.
5 Set up, erected.
6 Founded, endowed.
7 Placed in a post or situation.
E.
ष्ठा to stay or be, causal form, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Placing, having placed.
E.
स्था to place, causal v., क्तवतु aff.

n. (-म)
Strength, power.
E.
ष्ठा to stand or stay, Uṇādi aff. मनिन्.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Steady, firm, unchangeable, invariable.
2 Who or what stays, or is, &c.
m. (-यी)
A class of those feelings or passions which are the objects of poetic description: see the next.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, णिनि aff., युक् augment.

m. (-वः)
1 Fixed or permanent condition.
2 A feeling or passion, which is the object of poetical or dramatic description, and is classed sometimes as one of three, but more usually as one of two orders of such objects; this order being opposed especially to the Vyabhicārī Bhāvas: the feelings or conditions termed Sthāyi are eight, viz. desire, mirth, sorrow, heroism, anger, fear, aversion, and astonishment.
E.
स्थायिन् fixed, and भाव property.

Stationary.
2

Steady, firm.
m. (-कः)
The overseer of a village.
E.
ष्ठा to stand or be, उकञ् aff., and युक् augment.

mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं)
Boiled, dressed in a pot or boiler.
E.
स्थाली a pot, पक्व cooked.

n. (-लं)
The interior or hollow of a boiler.
E.
स्थाली a pot, and विल vacuity.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fit to be boiled or dressed.
E.
स्थालीविल the interior of a pot, छ aff.; also with यत् aff. स्थालीविल्य.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Fixed, stationary, stable, immoveable.
2 Regular, established.
m. (-रः)
A mountain.
n. (-रं)
1 A bow-string.
2 Immoveable property, land or houses.
3 Family property, jewels, &c. which have been long in a family, and which ought not to be sold or given away.
E.
ष्ठा to stand, वरच् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Perfuming the person, smearing the body with fragrant unguents, as of Sandal, &c.
2 A bubble of water or any fluid.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, स aff., and कन् added.

n. (-सु)
Bodily strength or capability.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, or be, सु aff.

mfn. (-स्नुः-स्नुः-स्नु)
1 Firm, stable.
2 Durable, eternal.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, स्नु aff.

f. (-ता)
Firmness, stability.
E.
स्थास्नु, and तल् aff.
